content:
ari: Heads up 1: We're hosting an external demo at 2pm today. Guest: Lina from RoverTech bringing a small demo robot (wheeled, swappable Li-ion battery pack) + a folded stroller for her toddler. Need badge, temp battery charging spot, and a short seat in lobby.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor scheduled: Lina (RoverTech), 1 adult + 1 child, ETA 14:00, host: ari. Badge will print on arrival.

marta: Noted. Two quick asks: 1) we cannot charge personal Li-ion batteries on the kitchenette outlet. 2) we have a dedicated charging cabinet in Mailroom C but need ops signoff.

josh: Ops: mailroom C cabinet ok for supervised charging for small demo batteries (lockbox only). Please log battery serial and supervise charging. No unattended charging.

ari: Great. Can someone reserve a bench seat by reception for 14:00:00 and a small soft chair for the toddler? Also can we reserve the lactation room for 14:30:30 in case needed?

felipe: I'll pop a temporary "Reserved for visitor" sign on the long bench and pull a foam toddler chair. Lactation room: blocked for 14:30:30 and note added to calendar.

marta: Front desk playbook update: check ID, print badge with note "demo battery in Mailroom C", sign battery log, escort to mailroom if docking battery immediately, and brief safety note about not leaving the battery unattended.

ari: Thanks! I'll message Lina to ask for battery specs and the stroller folded dims. Also asked them to bring the child carrier rather than leave stroller unattended if possible.

frontdesk-bot: Reminder: please flag any visitor with a child in the calendar so front desk can prep a soft seat and the family restroom code.

josh: Small safety note: if battery shows swelling or heat, unplug immediately and contact ops. We'll have a fire-suppressant small extinguisher in Mailroom C.

ari: All set. I'll confirm with RoverTech and update thread if anything changes. Thanks team :thumbsup:
